column3: “Why do you want” adds wanting; the Hebrew asks why they should be struck further. “Massive wound” stands for sickness of the whole head.
“Festering sores” stands for a fresh wound.
“Iniquity in solemn assembly” joins the expressions differently; the Hebrew coordinates iniquity and solemn assembly.
“Covered with blood” renders hands being full of blood.
“Best” renders the good of the land, without an expressed superlative.
“Only” is not expressed in the Hebrew.
The image of refining with lye is absent, and “impurities” generalizes the named metal.
“You will be ashamed” replaces the Hebrew “they”; “sacred” is not expressed.
